# EvAlert

> Communicate a persistent, in-page message about the status of a page, section, or action.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:alert` |
| Layer | Molecule (`src/molecules`) |
| Import | `import { EvAlert } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvAlert>` or `<ev-alert>` |
| Source | `src/molecules/alert/EvAlert.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<div class="ev-alert">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvAlert
  title="Pengajuan terkirim"
  subtext="Menunggu persetujuan atasan."
/>
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Alert**, frame `4147:63829` (Alert). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Surface a system message tied to a page or section — non-blocking feedback, a validation summary, or a status update that should stay visible.

### When not to use

- Transient confirmation (≤5s) → use Toast. Inline field-level error → use Hint. Blocking decision → use Modal (`evoq-ui:modal`).

### Do

- Match the variant to message severity. Keep the label ≤6 words, sentence case. Show one Alert per scope. Pair errors with a clear next step.

### Don't

- Don't use error for non-critical messages — it cries wolf. Don't use full paragraphs as the label. Don't stack competing alerts.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvAlert`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<div class="ev-alert">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:alert` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
